notes.title: We're Joining The Days of Ramadan Festival 2025!
notes.notes:
Dear Friends,

Get ready! We're thrilled to announce that we'll be participating in the 2025 Steam Days of Ramadan Festival, running from February 28th at 02:00 GMT+8 to March 31st, 2025, at 02:00 GMT+8!

The 2025 Steam Days of Ramadan Festival marks a first-of-its-kind event, bringing together indie game developers from around the globe for a Ramadan-themed sale. It's a fantastic opportunity for indie devs and game lovers to connect, share ideas, and celebrate Ramadan together.

During the festival, feel free to check out and play the latest games and grab some awesome discounts from across Asia! We hope you have a blast!

notes.title: A major update is now live!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your continued support! Over the past couple of days, we’ve rolled out a lot of optimization updates that you can experience once you update the game!

Here are the specific updates:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some items could not be picked up or were lost.
[*] Fixed bugs that caused certain processes to freeze.
[*] Fixed issues with some save errors.
[*] Optimized the gaming experience of some mini-games.
[*] Added hints for solving puzzles and a skip feature for certain puzzles.
[/list]

We really appreciate your ongoing support! We are still working hard on optimizing the game and adding localization features. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Reviver Mobile Launches January 21st!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Thank you so much for playing and enjoying Reviver, and a huge thank you for all the valuable feedback you've given us! ːSpeech_Loveː

We've received a ton of requests to bring the game to mobile, and we're really excited to make Reviver available on more of your favorite devices. That's why we've been working hard to optimize it for mobile, and to make sure you have an awesome time playing over the New Year holidays; we're thrilled to announce... ːsteamhappyː

[h1][b]Reviver officially launches on mobile on January 21st! That's just 4 days away![/b][/h1] ːlunar2019coolpigː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862343/ba6d43503ca726839b0f356787d0e885549b791b.png[/img]
The mobile version will include support for both iOS and Android devices, covering all screen sizes of phones and tablets (including iPads and Android tablets). We've done extensive optimization for different aspect ratios, ensuring a perfect, full-screen visual experience for all players! ːmlrem3ː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862343/8e026f170245efc7a72d46c63ec4453501128d5d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862343/13944efd11417f5d3735b77c8707279bd5f13029.jpg[/img]
Beyond that, we’ve also carefully optimized storage space, performance, and controls. The mobile version delivers high-quality visuals with low resource consumption and minimal heat generation. We also significantly reduced storage and RAM usage through lossless compression. ːmhwgoodː

As for touch controls and overall experience, we've made numerous adjustments to suit touchscreen interaction and the mobile gaming habits of our players, and even resized fonts and journals, so everything feels comfortable and easy to use! ːDaisyGJː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862343/907d48c6de79ac0a7cf8df0c9f848954638ad54a.png[/img]
In short, mobile Reviver isn't just a simple port. It's a version that's been carefully tailored for different device capabilities, interaction methods, and player habits. We're confident it'll offer you a fantastic gaming experience on the go! ːDaisySHOCKː

The game is now available for pre-registration and pre-order on each platform. For iOS users, Reviver will have a free trial prologue, with the option to unlock all chapters via in-app purchase. The Android version is available for purchase to download. ːtobdogː

[h3][b]Mainland China[/b][/h3]
TapTap: https://www.taptap.cn/app/544279

App Store CN (Hidden for now - will be live Jan 21st): https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id1555671475

Kuai Bao: https://www.3839.com/a/165659.htm


[h3][b]Global[/b][/h3]
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cottongame.reviver

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1672909006


To celebrate the mobile launch and the Lunar New Year, mobile Reviver will be available at a 30% discount until February 5th. If you enjoy playing on mobile, we highly recommend giving it a try!ːsteammockingː

Regarding updates for the Steam version, we’re still hard at work and expect to have the next update out soon, which will include various bug fixes and gameplay improvements. We are also actively exploring more language localizations, and our current plan is to add French localization. Thank you for your continued support, and stay tuned!

notes.title: First Update Live! And Roadmap!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Massive thanks for the incredible support and enthusiasm for Reviver! We're thrilled to launch our first update, addressing several key areas based directly on your feedback.

[h1][b]Your voice matters! We value your thoughts immensely. Leave a review on Steam and help us shape Reviver into something truly special.[/b][/h1]

We've been diligently working through your reports, squashing bugs and polishing the experience. The update is ready to download; dive back in – your saves are safe and sound!

[b]Here’s a glimpse at what’s new:[/b]

[list]
[*] Revamped the 30-Year Sort minigame for improved flow and intuitiveness.
[*] Polished existing text for greater clarity and immersion.
[*] Resolved the Mac resolution switching issue.
[*] Restored missing artwork in specific levels.
[*] Addressed various miscellaneous gameplay enhancements.
[/list]

[h1][b]A sneak peek at what's on the horizon (in no particular order):[/b][/h1]

[olist]
[*] Trading Cards & Community Items are coming soon!
[*] Free Wallpaper DLC on its way.
[*] Ongoing bug fixes and performance optimization.
[*] Level and gameplay refinements in the pipeline.
[*] Russian localization.
[*] Korean localization.
[*] Steam Deck compatibility.
[*] And much more…
[/olist]

Thanks again for being part of this journey. We're passionately committed to refining Reviver and delivering the best possible experience. 

See you in-game!

notes.title: 《Reviver》launches on January 9th!
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone!

Mark your calendars! Reviver, our latest creation, launches on Steam January 9th! 
Prepare to be swept away by a narrative puzzle game weaving together romance, time travel, and destiny.ːDaisySHOCKː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2239130

Reviver represents a departure for CottonGame, delving deeper into storytelling and offering richer, more extensive text than our previous titles. 
Experience a poignant love story that spans a lifetime, from youthful exuberance to the golden years.ːDaisyGJː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840735/db25d6651fd574b60f5501f48c11ee1ebd0f648f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840735/2f05e8c683fa9dfbddb7cd2729e94e86d27c3ec6.jpg[/img]

True to its name, Reviver embraces the butterfly effect as its core mechanic. 
Your choices, made across different eras, ripple through time, dramatically altering the narrative's course. 
Avert disastrous outcomes with seemingly small decisions, rewriting fate itself!ːtobdogː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840735/dbd843e213fee95b6db599b520b3780a2b66a57a.png[/img]

ːsteammockingːNaturally, we've retained the signature CottonGame brain-teasing puzzles you've come to expect. 
To complement this, we've sprinkled in a variety of engaging minigames, offering delightful diversions throughout your journey.

Intrigued? Wishlist Reviver now to be notified the moment it releases!ːSpeech_Loveː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840735/c91cbeaecc20dc24d9b40b2b26cde418be6edb24.png[/img]
Stay tuned – more exciting news is on the horizon!

Warmly,ːSpeech_Loveː
CottonGame

notes.title: 🌟 New Demo Live Now! Join Our Prize-Winning Event🌟
notes.notes:
Hello Gamers!

Exciting news—Reviver joins the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames]Wholesome Games Celebration[/url][/b] from August 15-21! Celebrate games that bring joy and introspection.

[h2]What's in Store?[/h2]

Try our [b]new demo[/b], featuring enhanced prologue and fresh chapter one content. We've listened to your feedback and can't wait for you to see the improvements!
And you will have a chance to win exclusive gifts.

[h2]Your Feedback Matters![/h2]

Play the demo and help us refine Reviver by filling out the [url=https://forms.gle/7QoERsyoNJ8UxkKt8][b]feedback form[/b][/url]. Your insights are crucial!

[h2]Event Details[/h2]

Event Period: August 15th, 1 PM PT - August 22nd, 1 PM PT
How to Participate: Share anything related to Reviver on X or Discord and tag us!

X: @[url=https://x.com/CottonStudio]CottonStudio[/url]
Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/mrrXbVU2ut]Cotton Games[/url]

Prizes: We'll randomly select 6 winners from X and Discord participants
Prizes Include: Steam Keys for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1347600/_/]Dad's Monster House[/url], animated by Our animator-millim

[h2]Also Featuring Cotton Game Titles[/h2]

Don't miss out on other Cotton Game titles like [[b]Sunset Hills[/b], gearing up for its upcoming release.
[b]Before Fate[/b], [b]Woolly Boy and the Circus[/b] and [b]The Lilliput Workshop[/b] are on the way!

[h2]Support and Follow[/h2]

Just a reminder that your free way to support an indie game is to wishlist it on Steam and encourage your friends to do the same!  

Wishlisting on Steam boosts games in algorithm - in short; the more wishlists, the more people the game will be suggested to.  

Small actions like this make a massive difference to getting the game out there,  especially for an indie team like Cotton Game! 

So if you like the look of any of the upcoming gems Cotton Games, please do consider hopping onto steam and clicking that wishlist button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862343/624e8753f134cd78f3b4b47c8d5f7b9d17e575b1.png[/img]

Thanks for your support! See you at the festival!

Cheers,

The Reviver Team
